test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GOOD' is written as '75' and 'FINE' is written as '82'. How will 'BEST be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Coded word = (Sum of opposite positional values) + 8

 
• In GOOD → 75 
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5177dc3eb5eb9394e9452eb36af6b00e8cdec5b7f83769b98940d4cf6af84d87.png] 
 
• Sum of opposite positional values = 20 + 12 + 12 + 23 = 67
 
• Coded word = 67 + 8 = 75
 
 

 

 
• In FINE → 82 ​
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae047becaf9d8c3a51fc31a6be1d2ac12784e40854fbce1bb85205336358ee02.png] 
 
• Sum of opposite positional values = 21 + 18 + 13 + 22 = 74
 
• Coded word = 74 + 8 = 82
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, In BEST → ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/846016e0e659a604e70f1530b3d166823152bfb6d8af2c9c2081f983dd19788a.png] 
 
• Sum of opposite positional values = 25 + 22 + 8 + 7 = 62
 
• Coded word = 62+ 8 = 70
 
 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

62
